intro: San Marino's culture is Italian with proud republican traditions.

chapters.title: Medieval Days
text: Every summer, Medieval Days fill the old town with crossbow contests, costumes and markets.

chapters.title: Food
text: Torta Tre Monti, a layered wafer cake named after the three towers, is a local speciality.

keyTerms.meaning: A medieval bow fired by a trigger.
